intro: One piece of roti planta has an estimated 420 kcal. Most of the calories come from the roti canai dough and the generous margarine spread, plus sprinkled sugar.
diet: Yes, but think of it as a treat, not a regular breakfast. It's high in fat and sugar but low in protein. So you get hungry fast even though the calories are already high. Once in a while with a kosong drink, no problem.
tips: Ask for no sugar or less sugar to save calories.
Share one piece with your partner or kids if you just want a taste.
Pair it with a half-boiled egg for extra protein.

swap.name: Roti canai kosong + kuah dal
swap.why: No extra margarine and sugar, so lower in fat and sugar.

faq.q: Are roti planta and roti bom the same?
faq.a: Almost. Roti bom is usually thicker and smaller, spread with margarine and sugar. Roti planta is thinner and wider.

faq.q: Is roti planta okay for kids?
faq.a: Once in a while as a treat is fine. For daily breakfast, choose something with protein like roti telur or capati with dal.

faq.q: Do you eat roti planta with kuah?
faq.a: Many people eat it on its own because it's sweet. Some like to dip it in kuah kari for a sweet-salty taste.
